facts.notes: Pay-as-you-go increment on Hobby plan: $5 buys 1,000 credits, and Scrape/Crawl/Map each cost 1 credit per page, so this equals $5 per 1,000 pages scraped on that plan.
facts.excerpt: A 5 USD increment is 1,000 credits on Hobby, 2,000 on Standard, 2,500 on Growth, and 5,000 on Scale.

facts.notes: Free plan includes 1,000 credits/month, equivalent to about 1,000 pages scraped, no card required.
Cheapest paid plan (Hobby), billed yearly, includes 5,000 credits/month (~5,000 pages scraped or 2,500 searches).

crawl4ai.reason: Crawl4AI is a free open-source tool with no printed pricing; its Cloud API is in closed beta with no published prices.

jina-reader.reason: The page prices Reader API usage in tokens with a free token allowance and prints no per-page, per-1k-pages, per-browser-hour, or monthly plan figures without arithmetic conversion.

facts.notes: Starter plan: $19/month + pay-as-you-go, includes $19 prepaid platform usage credit (compute units at $0.2/CU, proxies, storage, etc.)
Hobby plan: 75,000 API credits/month, 25 concurrent requests
Freelance plan: 250,000 API credits/month, 50 concurrent requests
Developer plan Fetch API overage rate (no proxies); with proxies it's $4/1k calls, or $4-$7/1k with Extract
facts.excerpt: then $1/1k calls, $4/1k calls with proxies. With Extract: $4/1k calls, $7/1k calls with proxies
